extra_turn_creation.terminal_postcondition: Most recently created extra turn is taken first: P3 extra, then P2 extra, then normal turn order resumes.
extra_turn_creation.consequence: Construction normalization MUST NOT copy extra_turn_creation from the request. Qualification credit for extra_turn_creation is available only after native rules execution actually creates and consumes the relevant extra turns and the event trace observes that execution.

game_action: GameAction.startGame performs native first-player determination and native mulligan processing through MulliganService before starting the first turn.
After mulligans it sets GameStage.Play, runs the NewGame trigger, sets the starting player, then calls PhaseHandler.startFirstTurn(first,startGameHook).
phase_handler: PhaseHandler.setupFirstTurn rejects an already-started turn sequence, sets the first player, advances from phase=null to the first phase, executes that phase's turn-based action, then runs startGameHook before entering mainGameLoop.
The hook therefore occurs after native mulligan processing and after first-turn setup, not at registration time.

reason: PLAYER_COUNT_* records can use a post-mulligan/pre-main-loop lifecycle snapshot with provider-neutral normalization of Forge's internal first-turn phase state, provided deck/opening-hand/RNG facts are reconstructed from native state.

PILOT_MULLIGAN and WS05-CMD-MULL-2/4 require evidence from the actual MulliganService/controller callback sequence; a snapshot only after setupFirstTurn is too late to prove the declared mulligan checkpoint and decision sequence.
Natural-start RNG must be installed before Match.prepareAllZones/native library shuffles, not inside the later startGameHook.
natural_start_adjudication.required_remediation: Install the tracing rules RNG before Match.startGame, observe mulligan callbacks/events during MulliganService, and emit the natural lifecycle snapshot from the appropriate native checkpoint instead of Ws40SuccessorState.emitNaturalRegistration before match.startGame.

next_action: Implement the WS45 generated overlay with construction-only native observations separated from behavior-event fields, then add native mulligan lifecycle tracing and pre-Match RNG installation for the seven NATURAL_GAME_START records.
